CPU_CEILING.enforcement: RLIMIT_CPU set in the executor before arithmetic; the prelaunch verifier refuses if the authorization's ceilings differ

PRECISION_POLICY.justification: the R1 real front-end refuses any precision other than 256; R1 and R2 precision studies classify the producer as STAGNATING (width floors are mathematical: truncation, residual and resolvent terms, not rounding); the R4 certificates are frozen at 256. Escalation cannot convert INCONCLUSIVE and would only add exposure.
PRECISION_POLICY.rule: one frozen rung. Execute at 256; the result at 256 is final for this protocol whatever its verdict.

PRODUCER_R4_IDENTITY.executor_binding_sha256: SET_AT_ACTIVATION: sha256 of the qualified EXECUTION_BINDING_AMENDMENT.json

PROTOCOL_FREEZE_COMMIT: SET_AT_ACTIVATION: the commit that introduced protocol/SCIENCE_PREREGISTRATION_R2.json (verified by git)
activation_rule: Only a separate explicit user authorization may produce an activated copy at the fixed path protocol/AUTHORIZATION_ACTIVE.json (EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED true, every SET_AT_ACTIVATION field filled, AUTHORIZED_BY and AUTHORIZATION_UTC set, NO self-claimed commit), committed once and pushed after the executor amendment commit. AUTHORIZATION_COMMIT is derived from git by the prelaunch verifier. This template is never edited.
